extracted.name: Cookie Cake
extracted.description: This is my first recipe and I would like to stay anonymous, so just call me the 13 year old chef, recipe in our family for a while, and I would like to share it!
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp sea salt (any salt works if you don't have it)
instruction_lines: Mix the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Cream butter, sugar, and brown sugar, then add the eggs and vanilla and mix.
Add the chocolate chips. Transfer the batter to a round pan.
Put in the oven in 5 minute intervals until the top is baked
Let set until cooled and enjoy!
